title: What will Donald Trump say during midterm rally in Salina, Kansas originally scheduled for October 31, 2026 and rescheduled for November 1, 2026? Farm / Farmer
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Farm / Farmer as part of midterm rally in Salina, Kansas originally scheduled for October 31, 2026 and rescheduled for November 1, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the midterm rally in Salina, Kansas originally scheduled for October 31, 2026 and rescheduled for November 1, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the midterm rally in Salina, Kansas originally scheduled for October 31, 2026 and rescheduled for November 1, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: The Salina rally was cancelled, then officially rescheduled for Sunday, Nov. 1 at the Salina airport hangar, and it is listed on the GOP events site. Trump's long rally speeches, especially in farm states like Kansas, almost always praise or discuss farmers, tariffs and agriculture. The main risk is another cancellation or an unusually short appearance.
blind.falsifier: The Nov. 1 Salina rally is cancelled again or turned into a tele-rally, or the full transcript or video shows Trump never said 'farm,' 'farmer,' 'farmers' or a possessive form.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.84 seems to price in substantial cancellation risk. I shade down slightly for that, but the rally is officially rescheduled and Trump almost always mentions farmers in a farm-state speech, so 0.89 is still above the ask.
